    scores = Counter()
    for other, other_areas in agent_areas.items():
        if other == agent_id:

        overlap = len(my_areas & other_set)
        if overlap == 0:

        scores[other] = overlap * 10 + bonus

    for citer in citer_set.get(agent_id, set()):
        if citer != agent_id:
            scores[citer] += 5

    top = scores.most_common(n)
    results = []
    for agent, score in top:

        ("FULL ordering",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i]))),
    ]

    q = frac(spec.get("per_unit_q", spec.get("statistic_level_set", 8) / spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)))
    k = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    alpha = frac(spec.get("alpha", 0.05))
    group_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)

    suggestions = []
    ladder = q_ladder_s4() if group_order == 24 else []
    
    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            new_p = rung["q"] ** k
            works = new_p <= alpha
            suggestions.append(dict(
                route="sharpen_statistic",
                description=f"Use '{rung['statistic']}' statistic (q = {f2s(rung['q'])}, vs current {f2s(q)})",
                new_k=k, new_q=rung["q"], new_p=new_p, works_at_alpha=works,
                cost="theoretical: stronger prediction must be pre-registered"))

    budget = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=k)
    if budget.get("deficit_units", 0) > 0:
        suggestions.append(dict(
            route="add_disjoint_units",
            description=f"Add {budget['deficit_units']} more disjoint unit(s) (k = {k} -> {budget['k_needed']})",
            new_k=budget["k_needed"], new_q=q, new_p=budget["p_at_needed"],
            works_at_alpha=True,
            cost="computational: more data / more blocks — independence MUST be verified"))

    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            b = gate5_unit_budget(rung["q"], alpha, current_k=k)
            deficit = b.get("deficit_units", 0)
            if deficit > 0 and deficit < budget.get("deficit_units", 99):
                suggestions.append(dict(
                    route="both",
                    description=f"'{rung['statistic']}' statistic + {deficit} more unit(s) "
                                f"(k = {k} -> {b['k_needed']})",
                    new_k=b["k_needed"], new_q=rung["q"], new_p=b["p_at_needed"],
                    works_at_alpha=True,
                    cost=f"mixed: sharper claim + {deficit} more blocks"))

    def score(s): return (0 if s["works_at_alpha"] else 1, float(s["new_p"]))
    suggestions.sort(key=score)
    return suggestions

def certify(spec):
    results = []

    n_units = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    unit_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)
    alpha = spec.get("alpha", 0.05)
    
    default_sharing = "disjoint" if n_units > 1 else "complete"
    sharing = spec.get("sharing_graph", default_sharing)
    
    # DEFECT 4 FIX: sharing_verified flag
    sharing_verified = spec.get("sharing_verified", False)
    
    randomization = spec.get("randomization", "exact")
    n_shuffles = spec.get("n_shuffles", None)

    if "per_unit_q" in spec:
        q = frac(spec["per_unit_q"])
    elif "statistic_level_set" in spec:
        q = F(spec["statistic_level_set"], unit_order)
    else:
        q = F(1, 3)

    null_support = spec.get("null_support_size", None)
    observed_p = spec.get("observed_p", None)
    n_competing = spec.get("n_competing_claims", 2)

    # G0
    g0 = gate0_null_validity(null_support)
    results.append(g0)

    # G1
    g1 = gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_order, alpha, sharing,
                                  randomization, n_shuffles, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g1)

    # G2
    g2 = gate2_statistic_resolution(q, n_units, alpha, sharing, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g2)

    # G3
    if observed_p is not None:
        stat_floor = g2["floor"]
        design_floor = g1["floor_conservative"]
        g3 = gate3_saturation(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha,
                               randomization, n_shuffles)
        results.append(g3)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G4
    if observed_p is not None:
        g4 = gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=q, n_units=n_units,
                             stat_floor=g2["floor"], null_support_size=null_support,
                             randomization=randomization, n_shuffles=n_shuffles)
        results.append(g4)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G4 EXACTNESS", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G5
    g5 = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=n_units)
    results.append(g5)

    # G6
    N = g1["N_outcomes"]
    g6 = gate6_discrimination(N, alpha, n_competing_claims=n_competing,
                               sharing_verified=sharing_verified, n_units=n_units)
    results.append(g6)

    # Summary
    passed = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "pass"]
    failed = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "fail"]
    conditional = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "conditional"]
    not_checked_list = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "not_checked"]
    
    all_verified_pass = len(failed) == 0  # nothing fails; conditionals are not failures

    # Trichotomy
    design_capable = g1["capable_under_some"]
    stat_capable = g2["pass_"] if g2.get("pass_") is not None else None

    if not design_capable:
        trichotomy = "A — DESIGN INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is False:
        trichotomy = "B — DESIGN CAPABLE, STATISTIC INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is True:
        trichotomy = "C — BOTH CAPABLE"
    else:
        trichotomy = "? — NOT FULLY CHECKED"
    
    if n_units > 1 and not sharing_verified:
        trichotomy += " (conditional on declared independence)"

    advisor = design_advisor(spec, results) if g2.get("pass_") == False else []

    return dict(
        gates=results,
        n_pass=len(passed), n_fail=len(failed),
        n_conditional=len(conditional), n_not_checked=len(not_checked_list),
        total_gates=len(results),
        all_verified_pass=all_verified_pass,
        trichotomy=trichotomy,
        design_floor_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"],
        stat_floor_bits=g2["bits"],
        headroom_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"] - g2["bits"],
        capacity=g6["capacity"],
        can_rank=g6["can_rank_n_claims"],
        sharing_verified=sharing_verified,
        alpha=alpha, q=q, k=n_units, N=N,
        randomization=randomization, sharing=sharing,
        advisor=advisor,
    )


def fmt_cert(cert):
    lines = []
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("  UNIFIED p-VALUE CERTIFICATION  ·  7 gates  ·  1 verdict")
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"  Design: k = {cert['k']} units, q = {f2s(cert['q'])}, "
                 f"alpha = {cert['alpha']}, N = {cert['N']} outcomes")
    lines.append(f"  Randomization: {cert['randomization']}  ·  "
                 f"Sharing: {cert['sharing']}  ·  "
                 f"Independence verified: {cert['sharing_verified']}")
    
    if cert["n_conditional"] > 0:
        lines.append(f"  ⚠  {cert['n_conditional']} gate(s) CONDITIONAL on declared "
                     f"independence (not verified from data)")
    
    lines.append(f"  Design resolution (max): {cert['design_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Statistic resolution:    {cert['stat_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Unused headroom:         {cert['headroom_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Discrimination capacity: {cert['capacity']}")
    lines.append(f"  Trichotomy:  {cert['trichotomy']}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("  GATES")
    lines.append("  " + "-" * 74)
    for g in cert["gates"]:
        lines.append(f"  {g['verdict']}")
        if g.get("detail"):
            lines.append(f"     {g['detail']}")
        lines.append("")

    if cert["advisor"]:
        lines.append("  DESIGN ADVISOR — suggested routes to significance")
        lines.append("  " + "-" * 74)
        for i, s in enumerate(cert["advisor"], 1):
            mark = "✓" if s["works_at_alpha"] else "·"
            lines.append(f"  {mark}  {i}. [{s['route']}] {s['description']}")
            lines.append(f"      new p = {f2s(s['new_p'])}  (k={s['new_k']}, q={f2s(s['new_q'])})")
            lines.append(f"      cost: {s['cost']}")
            lines.append("")

    lines.append(f"  Summary: {cert['n_pass']} pass, {cert['n_fail']} fail, "
                 f"{cert['n_conditional']} conditional, {cert['n_not_checked']} not checked")
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    return "\n".join(lines)
